in_hebrew.name: דורוטיון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דורוטיון הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מתנה של אלוהים'. הוא מורכב מהמילים 'דורוס' (מתנה) ו'תאוס' (אלוהים). השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים ובמסורת הכנסייתית.

in_greek.name: Δοροθέον
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Δοροθέον είναι χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'δώρο του Θεού'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος προκύπτει από τις λέξεις 'δωρον' (δώρο) και 'θεος' (Θεός). Το όνομα αυτό έχει ιστορικά χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία και στη χριστιανική παράδοση.

in_latin.name: Dorotheon
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dorotheon origine Graeco, significationem habet 'donum Dei' seu 'munus divinum'. Compositum est ex vocibus 'doros' (donum) et 'theos' (Deus). In traditione christiana et ecclesiastica nomen hoc usitatum est.

in_english.name: Dorotheon
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dorotheon originates from Greek roots, specifically from the words 'doron' (gift) and 'theos' (God), signifying 'gift of God' or 'divine gift'. Historically, the name has been used within Christian tradition, symbolizing a child as a precious gift from God. It carries spiritual significance, reflecting the belief in God's providence and benevolence.

data.cultural_impact: Dorotheon, as a Christian name, carries the cultural significance of being derived from the Greek name Dorothea, which signifies a gift from God. This name was popular among early saints and martyrs in the Christian faith, and holds a rich history within spiritual communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Dorotheon, as a name, highlights the importance of faith and divine grace in a person's life. It is a reminder of the ultimate gift that God has bestowed upon humanity - the gift of faith and salvation. This spiritual significance has made Dorotheon a beloved and inspiring name within the Christian community.
